## Summary
Aaron Larson convened a weekend production check-in with the team to review Sunday's service and plan technical adjustments for the upcoming weekend. The group agreed to adjust the livestream start time, implement a new opening lighting preset, and defer a second stage monitor purchase due to budget constraints. However, the arrival of a replacement camera cable remains uncertain, and the proposal for in-ear monitoring was shelved for future consideration.

## Decisions
- Livestream countdown timer will start at 9:25 AM going forward.
- A dimmer preset will be run for the opening song to signal the start of service.
- The second confidence monitor on stage will not be added this quarter due to budget limits.

## Action items
- Jenna — Rebuild announcement slides using current graphics from the comms team (this week)
- Jenna — Update the countdown timer in Pro Presenter
- Aaron — Reprogram the opening lighting cue before Thursday rehearsal
- Aaron — Check tracking status on the camera cable and text the group thread tonight

## Open questions
- Will the new Camera 3 SDI cable arrive before Sunday service?
- Whether the band will switch to in-ear monitors for the next year's gear budget review.

## Summary
Aaron and Speaker 1 met to troubleshoot a flickering north lobby screen and update the announcement graphics. They identified a damaged HDMI cable as the cause and agreed to replace it before the weekend while installing the new loop file. They also deferred the decision to replace the media player and noted the south screen brightness issue for later review.

## Decisions
- Switch to the new announcement loop starting Sunday morning.
- Replace the damaged HDMI cable on the north lobby screen.

## Action items
- Aaron — Swap out the loose HDMI cable (due before the weekend)
- Speaker 1 — Export and upload the new announcement loop file (due this afternoon)
- Aaron and Speaker 1 — Monitor the north lobby screen during the live feed on Sunday
- Speaker 1 — Price out new media player options (no commitment)

## Open questions
- The dimming issue on the south lobby screen will be investigated at a later time.
- Whether to purchase a new media player to replace the aging unit.

## Summary
Aaron called warranty support to address a failing projector lamp at Northwoods Community Church that is causing thermal shutdowns and dimming. Support confirmed the unit is under warranty and agreed to process a replacement for the primary lamp. They discussed using eco mode as a temporary workaround for the upcoming weekend while waiting for the replacement label.

## Decisions
- File a warranty claim for the failing primary lamp.

## Action items
- Aaron — send serial number and purchase receipt via email (this afternoon)
- Aaron — run projector in eco mode for the upcoming weekend
- Dana — validate receipt and generate RMA/label (by tomorrow)
- Marcus — investigate second lamp coverage

## Open questions
- Whether the second lamp module is covered under the same warranty window.
- Budget approval for replacing the entire projector with a laser model in the future.

## Summary
The team finalized the November camera schedule, deciding to run two manned positions per service instead of three to accommodate limited volunteer availability. They agreed to use Planning Center for sign-ups starting Friday and assigned Tyler to manage the separate graphics schedule. Thanksgiving staffing was noted as uncertain and deferred until further notice.

## Decisions
- Run two camera positions per service (center close and side) in November with the wide locked off.
- Use Planning Center for volunteer sign-ups for the four November weekends.
- Tyler will own and build the schedule for stream graphics separately.

## Action items
- Aaron — Build draft schedule template (due Friday)
- Dana — Nudge regulars to claim slots (over the weekend)
- Tyler — Text Marcus for shadow training
- Tyler — Build graphics schedule
- Aaron — Ask worship team for Thanksgiving service plan

## Open questions
- Specific date for Marcus's shadow training.
- Thanksgiving service plan and staffing availability.

## Summary
Aaron and Devin reviewed the technical status following weekend services for Northwoods Community Church, focusing on backup failures, patching results, and booth switch reliability. They agreed to defer discussions on cloud migration for now and established immediate troubleshooting steps for the failing switch and patch reporting. Aaron will handle direct vendor contact for the LED wall while Devin prepares a written summary of the IT scope and patch status.

## Decisions
- Cloud migration discussions are paused for future consideration due to cost concerns.
- Ownership of the LED wall vendor contact is assigned to Aaron.

## Action items
- Aaron — Power cycle the booth switch tonight and confirm stability through Wednesday rehearsal.
- Devin — Complete workstation checks and email patch summary/report to Aaron by Monday.
- Devin — Investigate why backup job hangs overnight and fold into Monday writeup.
- Aaron — Coordinate with the panel vendor for the dead LED wall tile section.

## Open questions
- Root cause of the media NAS backup job failing overnight.
- Whether moving media files to the cloud is viable cost-wise.

## Summary

## Summary
Aaron and Speaker 1 met to troubleshoot flickering on the north lobby screen and deploy a new announcement loop. They discovered the issue was caused by a loose and damaged HDMI cable rather than the hardware or files. The team agreed to replace the cable and install the new loop before Sunday, with plans to verify the fix during the live feed.

## Decisions
- Aaron will replace the loose HDMI cable before the weekend.
- The new announcement loop will be deployed on Sunday morning.
- Both will monitor the north screen during Sunday's live feed to confirm the fix.

## Action items
- Aaron — swap the damaged HDMI cable (due before the weekend)
- Speaker 1 — export and upload the new announcement loop (due this afternoon)

## Open questions
- Whether to replace the old media player in the future (Speaker 1 will get numbers later, no commitment yet).
- The dim brightness on the south hallway screen (to look at another day).

## Summary
Aaron contacted warranty support to report a failing projector lamp that caused a thermal shutdown during service. Support confirmed the unit is under warranty and will ship a replacement lamp. Aaron agreed to provide documentation and operate the projector in eco mode until the new part arrives.

## Decisions
- Proceed with filing a warranty claim for the failing projector lamp.

## Action items
- Aaron — Email serial number and purchase receipt to warranty support (this afternoon)
- Aaron — Configure projector to run in eco mode for the upcoming weekend
- Dana — Validate receipt and send RMA and shipping label to Aaron (by tomorrow)

## Open questions
- Whether the second lamp module in the dual-lamp projector is covered under the same warranty window
- Budget approval for potentially replacing the entire projector unit instead of just the lamp

## Summary
The team met to plan the November camera volunteer schedule, finding that staffing three cameras per service was unsustainable with their current pool of volunteers. They decided to reduce the setup to two manned positions per service (center close and side) with the wide camera locked off. Aaron will finalize the schedule template by Friday, while Tyler agreed to manage the graphics schedule and arrange training for Marcus.

## Decisions
- November camera schedule will feature two manned positions per service (center close and side), with the wide camera locked off.
- Volunteer sign-ups for November will open on Planning Center.
- Tyler will own and manage the graphics schedule for November.

## Action items
- Aaron — Build schedule template by Friday
- Aaron — Open Planning Center sign-ups this week
- Dana — Nudge regular volunteers to claim shifts before sign-ups go live
- Tyler — Text Marcus to arrange a shadow weekend for graphics training
- Tyler — Manage November graphics schedule (separate from camera sign-ups)
- Aaron — Confirm Thanksgiving service schedule with worship team

## Open questions
- Thanksgiving weekend staffing and whether a single service is planned remain uncertain.

They agreed to pause the cloud migration discussion and assigned the LED wall vendor contact to Aaron.
